ariaLabel: A happy dog beside a bone and a heart on grass.
A worried dog near water, showing that this is not its normal habitat.
An excited dog playing beside a ball on grass.
A calm dog resting on a mat.
A whale swimming through the ocean.
A bird flapping gently above a tree branch.
A cow beside fresh grass, chewing calmly.
An inflated balloon beside a burning candle, two observations that teach us about air.
Moving air blows toward a windmill whose blades are turning.
A kite moving in the air while wind blows across the sky.
Wind pushes a sailboat across water.
A green plant in sunlight with gentle air moving past its leaves.
Germination in order: a seed begins to grow into a sprout and then a young plant.
A pair of lungs with air moving in and out to reinforce that lungs help us breathe.
Earth rotating beside the Sun to reinforce that Earth's rotation causes day and night.
Ocean waves with a salt label, showing that sea water is salty.
A hole-filled piece of pumice shown at the surface of water.
Melting in order: solid ice changes into liquid water.
Freezing in order: liquid water changes into solid ice.
Opening in order: a closed container changes to an open container.
Filling in order: an empty container becomes partly full and then full.
